result.text:
Quoted fields like `"Müller, Hans"` now import correctly, and all 96 tests pass (93 existing plus 3 new).

The bug was in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts`, which splits every line on `,` and ignores quotes. That folder is vendored and overwritten by the platform sync every Monday, so I left it alone. Instead I added `src/lib/csv.ts`, which has a quote-aware parser. It handles commas inside quotes, `""` escapes, newlines inside quotes, CRLF, blank lines and a BOM. It builds the same row shape as the legacy parser. I changed `src/routes/import.ts` to use it.

`parseLegacyCsv` is still exported and its existing test is unchanged.

The new tests are in `test/csv-quoted.test.ts`. They cover the `"Müller, Hans"` row at parser level, the escaping and newline cases, and a POST /import with that name. That last one creates the shipment with no errors.

The error `line` numbers in the import response still count non-blank records, as before. If a quoted field spans several physical lines, the number refers to the record, not the file line.

I didn't update `.gemkeeper/ledger.md`. Nothing in this task changed the mission or rules.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- Work on parcel-tracker (shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). Task 1: calculateEta (src/services/eta.ts) must skip Austrian public holidays, not just weekends; add tests + run them.
- User works autonomously-style: reviews everything at the end (user).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) No new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — each new package needs security review (~6 weeks).

## Decisions
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay byte-for-byte unchanged (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. New fields (e.g. `eta` on list items) go only on GET /shipments. Don't touch shipmentToApi in a way that leaks into /:id.
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ONLY carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (algorithm in docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days.
- (user) Austrian public holidays = hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet; must work fully offline.

## Rules (cont.)
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (shown verbatim to warehouse packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

## Rules (cont. 2)
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone anywhere (GDPR personal data; data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.

## Facts
- `npm start` = node src/server.ts; `npm test` = node --test (files in test/). Env: PORT, DATA_FILE, ERP_URL; config/default.json.
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is flaky (~1 in 5 on CI, timer race in fake notifier), tracked OPS-412, owned by platform team: if it fails, rerun once, do NOT try to fix it.
- .gemkeeper/ is not in .gitignore (open question below).

## Facts (ERP)
- ERP webhook signing: `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 (secret env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over JSON body WITHOUT the `sig` field, sent as top-level `sig` in the body (src/services/notify.ts, src/config.ts). Unset secret → unsigned + one warning (my choice; rollout ERP-1182).
- ERP payload now uses documented names event_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, event_type, occurred_at (toErpPayload in src/services/notify.ts; test/erp-payload.test.ts). Optional `note` NOT sent (free carrier text, not requested).

## Decisions (cont.)
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no exponential backoff, on network error or 5xx — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land inside it or the ERP gets duplicate events. Delay must be injectable for tests.

- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json); do NOT move to SQLite (node:sqlite) — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, a binary DB breaks their backup checks. Slowness is solved by debouncing writes in src/store.ts (200 ms window, one write per window) + flush() on shutdown.

- ETA is computed fresh on every call (memoization was removed). Measured: ETA part of a 500-item list is <2 ms, it was never the bottleneck of the slow GET /shipments on staging (166-348 ms already BEFORE e
